changeSet.author: antigravity
changeSet.sql:
-- For drivers with exactly 1 distinct team in driver_result (excluding team_id = -1 and nulls) UPDATE driver_mapping dm SET team_id = ( SELECT MIN(dr.team_id) FROM driver_result dr JOIN session_result sr ON dr.session_result_id = sr.id JOIN tier t ON sr.tier_id = t.id WHERE dr.telemetry_name = dm.telemetry_name AND dr.race_number = dm.race_number AND dr.driver_id = dm.driver_id AND COALESCE(dr.country, 'Unknown') = COALESCE(dm.country, 'Unknown') AND t.league_id = dm.league_id AND dr.team_id IS NOT NULL AND dr.team_id != -1 ), is_reserve = false WHERE ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dr.team_id) FROM driver_result dr JOIN session_result sr ON dr.session_result_id = sr.id JOIN tier t ON sr.tier_id = t.id WHERE dr.telemetry_name = dm.telemetry_name AND dr.race_number = dm.race_number AND dr.driver_id = dm.driver_id AND COALESCE(dr.country, 'Unknown') = COALESCE(dm.country, 'Unknown') AND t.league_id = dm.league_id AND dr.team_id IS NOT NULL AND dr.team_id != -1 ) = 1;
-- For drivers with multiple teams (or 0 teams) in driver_result UPDATE driver_mapping dm SET is_reserve = true, team_id = NULL WHERE ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dr.team_id) FROM driver_result dr JOIN session_result sr ON dr.session_result_id = sr.id JOIN tier t ON sr.tier_id = t.id WHERE dr.telemetry_name = dm.telemetry_name AND dr.race_number = dm.race_number AND dr.driver_id = dm.driver_id AND COALESCE(dr.country, 'Unknown') = COALESCE(dm.country, 'Unknown') AND t.league_id = dm.league_id AND dr.team_id IS NOT NULL AND dr.team_id != -1 ) != 1;
